# Security Policy

## Supported versions

bootstrap-ng is in early development. Security fixes are made on the `main` branch and released in the latest published version on npm. Older versions do not receive fixes.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest  | Yes       |
| Older   | No        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions or pull requests.

Instead, report them privately through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/bootstrap-ng/bootstrap-ng/security/advisories/new): open the repository's **Security** tab and select **Report a vulnerability**.

Please include as much of the following as you can:

- The affected component, directive or file
- The version of bootstrap-ng, Angular and Bootstrap you are using
- Steps to reproduce, or a minimal example
- The impact, and how an attacker could exploit it

You should receive a response within a few days. Once the issue is confirmed, a fix will be prepared and released, and you will be credited in the advisory unless you prefer otherwise.

## Scope

This policy covers the bootstrap-ng library and its documentation site. Vulnerabilities in Angular or Bootstrap themselves should be reported to those projects.
